features.description: Android onboarding flow: splash → terms → location-permission prompt → home screen. Mirrors iOS visual design and copy. Implements the splash, terms, location-permission-pending, and home-populated states.
steps: Build SplashActivity with iOS-equivalent fade timing
Build TermsActivity with the same accept-or-quit semantics
Build LocationPermissionPrompt with rationale string identical to iOS
Build HomeActivity with Spin button + nearby restaurants list
features.acceptance: Splash → terms → location prompt → home renders identically to iOS for the success path. Empty home state shows the same Spin button affordance.

features.description: Android restaurant voting (Spin): wheel animation, card reveal, thumbs-up / thumbs-down / spin-again actions. Persists votes to local DB and syncs to backend. Honors 7-day thumbs-down cooldown.
steps: SpinViewModel drives wheel animation with iOS-matching ~1.2s duration
RestaurantCardView renders name / cuisine / distance / hours / price / rating
VoteRepository persists vote actions to Room DB and pushes to backend
Cooldown logic: thumbs-down restaurant excluded from spin pool for 7 days
features.acceptance: Tapping Spin animates the wheel and reveals a restaurant card. Thumbs-up / thumbs-down persist across app restarts and respect the 7-day cooldown.

features.description: Android saved lists: lists tab with cover thumbnails, list detail view, rename / reorder via long-press menu. Receive-shared-list flow via deep link.
steps: SavedListsTab renders all lists with 4-tile cover thumbnails (most-recent restaurants)
ListDetailActivity shows restaurants ordered by date-saved
Long-press menu surfaces Rename / Reorder / Share options
Deep-link handler /lists/shared/{token} routes to a shared-list landing screen
features.acceptance: Lists tab populates with cover thumbnails; long-press surfaces the action menu; share-link deep links route to the correct list.

features.description: Android subscription UX: Free-tier daily-spin counter (5/day) with Pro upsell at the limit; Pro purchase via Play Billing for monthly + annual SKUs; profile-tab subscription tile showing tier + renewal date.
steps: DailySpinCounter resets at local midnight; surfaces 'X spins left' on home
ProUpsellSheet triggers when free-tier user hits the daily limit
PlayBillingClient wires monthly + annual SKUs with the same prices as iOS
ProfileTab renders subscription tile with tier + renewal date + manage link
features.acceptance: Free tier enforces the 5-spin daily limit and surfaces the upsell at the limit. Pro purchase flow completes via Play Billing and the profile tile reflects the new tier within 30 seconds of purchase.

features.description: Espresso UI tests covering the four core flows on Android. Side-by-side screenshot comparison harness vs. iOS reference screenshots for each user journey's primary states.
steps: Espresso tests for onboarding success path
Espresso tests for spin → vote → cooldown
Espresso tests for saved-lists rename / reorder
Espresso tests for subscription purchase happy path
features.acceptance: All four Espresso suites green; side-by-side screenshot diffs within design-tolerance thresholds for primary states.
